payload.text: RESUME (localfold on hv's word, 2026-10-26 11:45Z by date -u; hv, verbatim: "Ok, context is high. Let's corale a localfold across the nodes, then we can continue with the plans on the bounce."). Build all ran at 629ce5ad2 and intentd was restarted. Skills were synced at 11:21Z (in-finish's IN-PR-STYLE-005 line) and announced to every vc. NEXT ON THE BOUNCE, in order: (1) THE FOLD-TEXT CHANGE, per decision 94. Nothing is written yet. File an Intent issue, with the human as reporter. Write the removal step, with its checks, into intent/plugins/claude/skills/in-whiteboard/SKILL.md's Folding section, the one home, and a pointer line in in-finish's localfold, with a CHANGELOG line under 3.2.7. Judge it: prettier, the verblock guard, the prose critic, and tests/unit/whiteboard_protocol_3_guard.bats and intent-cli's mcp.rs, which read these skills. Land it with land-one.sh in a chain, close the issue, then skills sync and announce. (2) RE-AIM THE KOVACS PREFLIGHT: run bin/int prepush --preflight-covers HEAD and send molt-vc the two order lines; the GO follows at once. The seal lands at ~/.local/share/intent/preflight/<sha>.summary and is green by its first line. Main takes board-only commits from the preflight's sha until the push. (3) devbin-vc pushes local and then upstream after the green seal; send devbin-vc the sha and the seal's path. (4) PART B'S TRAIN. cc's wp04b-status-v2 (4ae2585f7479), wp04b-wait-v2 (2421b3d9719d), ic's wp04b-page-v2 (8126a568631b) and cc's wp04b-init-v1 (e8aee9ac86d6) stack in that order on 34c7046ad to tip tree b8c3025dd884. READY goes to molt-vc for its judge with judge-rerun.sh, including bats CI-shaped and ic's render drive tools v3 (render-states.sh 96c9f5840582, prelude.js 942b1e87c794). Then the landings, build all, and a fresh preflight before the next upstream push. After the landing, cc owes the AT rows for AC-04.4, 04.5 and 04.6, design.md through the attachment door, and the measured cost of one pending call. (5) ic's app install once molt-vc says hv has quit Intent.app, with ic's xcodegen pre-check first; then the live check, then vc closes 0652. (6) devbin-vc's request for the worktree reading and both scripts (paths, sha256s, how each runs, a real output each, and the cases neither decides), answered after the seal. (7) THE WORKTREE REMOVALS, a light leg with START and END to molt-vc, on its word that hv has made the ~/Devel Spotlight exclusion. 41 are stale (cc 19, dc 13, ic 9). wt-vc-train, wt-cc-0086b and wt-ic-0086b are live. No push by vc, no release.
